blocks.text: Glad ForceFlex Drawstring Tall Kitchen Scented Trash Bags With Febreze provide stretchable strength plus odor control to keep your home smelling fresh and clean. These ForceFlex garbage bags trap, lock and neutralize unwanted trash odors while steadily releasing a Fresh Clean scent with Febreze freshness. These drawstring trash bags are designed with two layers for extra leak protection. RipGuard technology prevents ForceFlex trash bags from ripping to avoid leaks. Avoid tears with the ForceFlex technology, which gives the 13 gallon tall kitchen trash bags extra flex, letting them expand around sharp edges and heavy loads. Keep your trash can cleaner with the RipGuard technology and a durable grips-the-can drawstring that prevents the bag from slipping and makes closing easy. Each bag measures 1 foot 11 15/32 inches by 2 feet 1 3/8 inches, making it just the right size for most kitchen garbage cans.

items.label: FORCEFLEX TECHNOLOGY
items.value: Tall kitchen garbage bags expand around sharp edges and heavy loads, so you can pack in the trash without ripping the bag; Plus, the drawstring closure provides a comfortable grip

items.label: 2 LAYERS EXTRA LEAK PROTECTION
items.value: These 13 gallon kitchen trash bags are designed with 2 layers to handle heavy loads and help prevent rips, tears and leaks

items.label: SCENTED GARBAGE BAGS
items.value: These Glad kitchen trash bags with Febreze Freshness infuse your space with just a hint of sparkling Fresh Clean scent without being overwhelming for scent-sensitive households

items.label: GRIPS-THE-CAN DRAWSTRING
items.value: Durable 3-ply drawstrings grip the can so the tall trash bags stay in place and make it easy to close and carry; perfect for daily use in your active kitchen and home

items.label: 13 GALLON TALL GARBAGE BAGS
items.value: Each Glad ForceFlex bag measures 1 foot 11 15/32 inches by 2 feet 1 3/8 inches, making it just the right size for most slim kitchen garbage cans

items.value: Animal Waste, Baby Waste, Food Waste, Toilet Waste
